from.place: finite quotient descent and coefficient realization

title: Actual finite quotient realization and normalization
statement: Given X,d,phi,M,V,T with compatible invertible finite coefficient comparisons, perfect algebraic levels and separate local markings as in [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-stalk-models], there exists level data L as in [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-actual-levels] together with FinitePerfectAdicActualRealizationData X d M V T L. The etale levels are chosen together with their actual descent comparison, not supplied arbitrarily.

proof.text: Use the explicit exact finite scalar realization and its ordinary normalized scalar compositor, localized termwise. Descend the actual quotient diagram while retaining its comparison with that realization. Separately compare the realized constant complexes with the completed constant model, including their consecutive arrows. Assemble these actual and model comparisons and their normalized squares into the unchanged realization data structure.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09C6, actual finite quotient descent retaining K_n = epsilon inverse L_n; associated module realization and balancing, Tags 03CY and 06YY.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePerfectAdic_actual_realization
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale)
    (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d)
    (hperfect : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.IsPerfect (T.level n))
    (hmark : FinitePerfectAdicLevelMarkings X d φ M V T) :
    ∃ L : FinitePerfectAdicActualLevelData X d M V T,
      Nonempty (FinitePerfectAdicActualRealizationData X d M V T L)

statement_change.old_statement: theorem finitePerfectAdic_actual_realization ... : Nonempty (FinitePerfectAdicActualRealizationData X d M V T L)
statement_change.what: The old theorem quantified over an arbitrary L whose fields express only stalkwise agreement with T, not descent of M. Take I=0, A=F3, X=Spec(R), V=X, T the rank-one constant tower, and M the rank-one sign local system for Gal(C/R). Separate markings hold on Spec(C), and constant etale L satisfies all fields. Since L.K equals the constant model input, the old actual and model isomorphisms would identify the sign system with the trivial system on X, a contradiction. The source instead descends the actual quotient and retains its comparison. Quantify existentially over that chosen L. The parent already asks only for existence, so its statement is preserved.
